Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...I must decline. I have no time to play 
nice with others."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, was that too rude of me? No, 
but...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso lost her concentration, and her 
self-training ended up doing more harm 
than good...
